raw_sections.projects:
Projects Undertaken
Virtual Agent for Differentiated Customer Experience ● Developing a virtual agent to deliver personalized customer support using DialogFlow
CX
Classifying customer queries by intent and recommending resolution steps via LLM-based automation.
Enhancing customer service efficiency by intelligently routing queries to the appropriate channels.
Designing a multimodal pipeline using Gemini Pro Vision to generate self-help videos from product manuals, reducing human intervention.
Entity Abstraction from Documents ●
Implemented Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to extract structured information from diverse document categories.
Built end-to-end pipeline including text extraction, preprocessing, chunking, vector embeddings, semantic search, and LangChain integration.
Extracted 30+ fields (names, dates, amounts, receipt numbers) with improved accuracy and 25% faster development time compared to traditional ML-NLP methods. ● Collaborated with SMEs to optimize prompts and improve model performance.
Spreading and Underwriting Automation ● Automated entity extraction from financial documents (balance sheets, income
statements) and generated narrative insights for underwriters.
Processed and queried structured financial tables for LLM consumption. ● Leveraged one-shot and few-shot prompting to improve accuracy and consistency of narrative generation.
Feedback Tag AI Insight ● Built an AI system to analyze user feedback and tag voice assistant conversations. ● Used larger LLMs to generate multiple completions and fine-tuned smaller models for

cost-effective, high-performance feedback tagging. Implemented an open-source LLM-based solution to reduce operational costs while maintaining high accuracy.
Intelligent Email Advisor ● Developed NLP solution for extracting key information and identifying lines of business
for a leading insurance client.
Fine-tuned BERT models for intent classification and LoB identification, enabling automated email processing and workflow improvements.
Identification of Corroded Parts ● Built deep learning models to automatically identify corroded automotive parts from
underbody images captured during testing and service.
